cand.title: Announcement gives dates, Hard Rock venue, 106+ conferences, 15+ international guests and a joint component with 300+ Latin American specialists.
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence and destination fit; accessibility is reduced where venue is committed or sourcing is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified relevant organizer contacts, neither proven contract signatory: Dr. Carmen Encarnación, 2027 organizing-committee chair responsible for logistics/operations; Dr. Vizmary Pineda, SODOCARDIO president 2025–2027 and spokesperson at the launch. Carmen is the operational routing priority; Vizmary is an executive relationship and referral contact. No named accommodation procurement buyer was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Announced activity dates are 17–20 June 2027, within the requested horizon, at Hard Rock Hotel Punta Cana. These are event dates, not the June 2026 announcement dates. The national congress incorporates the III SIAC Cardiooncology Congress; do not count these as two independent hotel leads. Reports of the formal launch agree on dates and venue; no directly published 2027 society booking portal was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra is a plausible guestroom-led resort option for a separately approved subset of delegates or a smaller future society programme, not a credible like-for-like replacement for this congress. Its published 620 rooms, all-inclusive model, three modular meeting rooms totaling 380 m² and 200–300-person event capacity suit residential subgroups. The congress is reported to need five simultaneous academic rooms and expects more than 300 Latin American specialists through the joint component alone. This limits full-congress suitability independently of room inventory. No event-specific demand at Alltra is established.
findings.venueCommitments: Hard Rock Hotel Punta Cana convention center is the announced 2027 host venue. Planned RCP training for its staff reinforces the operational connection. This establishes an announced venue commitment, not inspection of a signed contract or proof of exclusive accommodation allocation.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified national-congress sequence: XXVIII, 3–6 June 2021, Punta Cana Convention Center; XXIX, 22–25 June 2023, Hard Rock Hotel convention center, Punta Cana; XXX, 19–22 June 2025, Punta Cana convention center, identified as Hard Rock in contemporaneous reporting; XXXI announced for 17–20 June 2027, Hard Rock. This demonstrates repeated Punta Cana hosting and Hard Rock incumbency, not destination rotation. The two-year spacing is observed; a formally mandated biennial rule and any post-2027 edition remain unverified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 lodging sourcing is unknown: no verified room block, rates, booking deadline, housing agency, overflow arrangement or open hotel RFP was located. Venue confirmation must not be treated as proof that all guestrooms are contracted or that external lodging is available. SODOCARDIO officially named Turinter the tour operator for 2025; its 2027 appointment is unverified.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led medical congress: Sociedad Dominicana de Cardiología (SODOCARDIO) is the national organizer; Sociedad Interamericana de Cardiología (SIAC) supplies the joint cardiooncology congress component. Hard Rock is the host hotel/venue, not the event owner. Turinter is a verified historical tour operator/organizing agency for 2025, not a verified 2027 PCO. Pharmaceutical/device companies are described as supporters, not accommodation buyers.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2027 congress venue is already announced at competing Hard Rock, also identified for 2023 and 2025. Five simultaneous academic rooms materially exceed Alltra’s published three-room meeting configuration. No sourced sell-out, room shortage, overflow requirement, alternative-hotel agreement or shuttle plan was found. Do not infer overflow from attendance or assume the 300+ specialists translate into 300 guestrooms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact SODOCARDIO’s public office and ask for Carmen Encarnación, copying/routing through Vizmary Pineda. Ask who controls 2027 accommodation, whether Hard Rock lodging is exclusive, whether any external rooms are required, and whether Turinter is retained. Only after a positive response request dates of stay, paid-room requirement, meeting configuration, transfer plan and decision timetable. If closed, request the planning calendar for smaller future residential programmes rather than pitching relocation of the five-track congress.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low for the main 2027 congress venue: announced elsewhere. External accommodation access is unconfirmed, not open and not proven closed. Treat as a qualification conversation only; do not forecast room nights or a displacement win.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship development is more defensible than pursuing the entire congress. Seek a smaller residential scientific meeting or independently authorized subgroup compatible with Alltra’s capacity; pursue 2027 accommodation only if organizers confirm an unallocated requirement. No subsequent-edition date, location or sourcing window is verified; do not invent a 2029 opportunity or recurring SIAC joint component.
